Chhattisgarh Government to Rotate Officials Every Three Years

The Chhattisgarh government has decided that officials and employees who have been in the same department or desk for three years will be transferred. This decision aims to bring a large administrative reshuffle, referred to as a 'big administrative surgery'. An order has been issued to implement this policy, ensuring rotation of responsibilities in government offices. The Chief Minister's office announced this decision, which will affect personnel across various government departments.
